description: Draw flowers in glass in the monoline geometric style on this project's Monoline card (monoline/): one pen on three angles, broken stems, blocks cut in two, dots in clusters, glass drawn by formula. Use for a new plant, garden or bottle in the vase, a palette that looks muddy or repeats, stems that cross or crowd, or a card that moves wrong, even if the user never says "skill".
